name: QA Handover Report
description: A compact QA and change report for hand-over, built only from saved snapshots, a rule pack and optional plan proof bundles. Writes JSON and Markdown to the workspace. Read-only.
author: AEC Model Bridge

snapshot_id.description: Saved snapshot to report on (the before state). Required when connected to Revit.

after_snapshot_id.description: Optional later snapshot of the same model, used to re-check the rules and confirm changed values.

plan_ids.description: Optional plan ids whose proof bundles are summarised as approved changes.

max_ids.description: Element ids listed per rule (1 to 30); counts are always complete.

output_name.description: File name without extension; written to reports/<name>.json and .md in the workspace.
